source: A ZXNAME0000XZ can execute an enormous number of arithmetic operations, but arithmetic units can only work on data that has reached them. The storage system therefore has to solve conflicting goals at once: keep enough total bytes for large models, deliver those bytes at high aggregate rates, and make frequently reused values available close to the execution units.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 可以执行大量算术运算，但算术单元只能处理已到达它们的数据。因此，存储系统必须立即解决相互冲突的目标：为大型模型保留足够的总字节，以高聚合速率交付这些字节，并使经常重用的值靠近执行单元可用。
